1. The three dark visible cubes form a straight row along the lower front.
2. The hatched upper-left \(2\times2\) block uses all four cubes of one piece.
3. The white piece visibly includes the two upper-right cubes and the lower rear-right cube. Its fourth cube must therefore be the lower rear-middle cube, since this is the only unassigned cube adjacent to the visible white cubes.
4. The remaining cube, at the lower rear-left, must belong to the dark piece.

Thus the dark piece consists of three cubes in a row with one cube attached behind an end, forming an \(L\)-shaped tetracube. This matches Shape B.
